name: BB72 supplementary timing T1: full-DEM Relay-BP's own mean time per shot at p = 0.002 on the Apple M4
status: Supplementary measurement made after the registered BB72 test (2026-10-09). It is not a registered result and it changes no registered file or result. RESULTS_stage3.md, results.json and the registered rows (rows_cpu.csv) are untouched.
why: The registered test (stage 3) timed full-DEM Relay-BP only at p = 0.003 (session B, 58.5963 ms, the bar of BB72-3F), because only that cell's speed gate needed it. At p = 0.002 it was not timed, so the poster and the paper draw it as a dashed accuracy line. This session measures it with session B's method, and first re-runs session B's p = 0.003 measurement as a control.

session.processes: one warm-up process, then three p = 0.003 processes, then three p = 0.002 processes, one at a time, each a fresh single-threaded python process
session.monitoring: while it ran, three ssh calls from the box read the logs (remote loops of 10-s sleeps; the last ended when the script exited); nothing else of ours ran on the Mac
session.waits: every idle check held at once (waited 0 s before each of the 7 processes)
observations: 1-min load 1.24-2.20 across the logged lines (session B's relay_full lines: 1.80-2.12). The logged top processes are macOS's own: the aerial wallpaper extension (at most 10.1 % CPU), WindowServer and VTDecoderXPCService, the same three as in session B's relay_full lines, and at times opendirectoryd and dasd.

The line logged before control process 2 (00:53:31) shows launchd at 28.2 % CPU. That ps sample was taken just after the idle check's own sample had passed (no process at >= 20 %), as process 1 exited; launchd handles process exits and launches. Control process 2 (58.49 ms) is the slowest of the three, 0.75 % above the fastest, and is not the counted one.
The only python process other than ours was the system Python 3.9 of the Command Line Tools, idle since boot (0.0 % CPU), the one that led to the narrowed check in session S.

The warm-up process's core check took 0.0477 s; the six timed processes' took 0.0494-0.0503 s (performance-core speed; the release gives 0.049-0.051 s for registered sessions A and B and 0.049-0.053 s for session S, to three decimals).

mac_T1.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# BB72 supplementary timing T1 (2026-10-09, after the test; a supplementary measurement, not a registered result):
# full-DEM Relay-BP's own mean time per shot at p = 0.002, the way quiet session B (mac_B.sh, 2026-10-07) timed it at
# p = 0.003, whose measurement is re-run first as a control. Session B's code copy, venv, shots, environment and command
# (bb.timing opponent, first 2,000 test shots of chunk 0, three fresh processes one after another); one warm-up pass of
# relay_full over 1,000 test shots as in session B; before every process the idle check as narrowed in session S
# (mac_S.sh). Writes only to $O.
W=~/work/bb72s3; C=$W/code; O=~/work/bb72_supp_t1
export PYTHONPATH=$C/ising_compare:$C/qldpc_neural BB_SHOTS=$W/shots BB_PREDS=$W/preds QND_RELAY=~/work/relay
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1 RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1
export BB_SESSION=mac-mini-m4-supp-T1
PY=~/work/.venv/bin/python; R=$O/rows_cpu_T1.csv; L=$O/load_T1.log
cd $C/ising_compare
top() { ps -Ao pcpu,comm -r | sed -n '2,4p' | awk '{printf "%s %s; ", $1, $NF}'; }
# idle = no process at >= 20 % CPU in ps, no python process at >= 1 % CPU, 1-min load < 3; wait (15-s steps) until it
# holds (mac_S.sh's check, verbatim)
idle() {
  local t0=$SECONDS
  until [ "$(ps -Ao pcpu= | awk '$1>=20' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 0 ] && [ "$(ps -Ao pcpu=,comm= | awk 'tolower($0) ~ /python/ && $1 >= 1' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 0 ] \
        && awk -v l="$(sysctl -n vm.loadavg | awk '{print $2}')" 'BEGIN{exit !(l<3)}'; do sleep 15; done
  echo "before $1 $(date +%T) idle (no process >= 20 % CPU, no python process >= 1 % CPU, load < 3; waited $((SECONDS-t0)) s) load $(sysctl -n vm.loadavg) | $(top)" >> $L
}
after() { echo "after $1 $(date +%T) load $(sysctl -n vm.loadavg) | $(top)" >> $L; }
echo "== session T1 start $(date +%T)"
echo "python processes at the start: $(ps -Ao pid=,pcpu=,etime=,comm= | grep -i python | awk '{printf "pid %s %s %% CPU up %s %s; ", $1, $2, $3, $4}')" >> $L
idle warm-up; $PY -m bb.timing opponent --code bb72 --p 0.003 --dec relay_full --split test --chunks 1 --first 1000 --out $O/warmup_T1.csv > /dev/null; after warm-up
echo "== control: relay_full p0.003 $(date +%T)"
for k in 1 2 3; do idle "relay_full-own p0.003 proc$k"; $PY -m bb.timing opponent --code bb72 --p 0.003 --dec relay_full --split test --chunks 0 --first 2000 --proc $k --out $R > /dev/null; after "relay_full-own p0.003 proc$k"; done
echo "== relay_full p0.002 $(date +%T)"
for k in 1 2 3; do idle "relay_full-own p0.002 proc$k"; $PY -m bb.timing opponent --code bb72 --p 0.002 --dec relay_full --split test --chunks 0 --first 2000 --proc $k --out $R > /dev/null; after "relay_full-own p0.002 proc$k"; done
echo "SESSION_T1_END $(date +%T)"
